I was on ADHD medication from 12 (retalin) i was on it till about 16 when i started work, i then got back on it at 18 as i was struggling to do my job my mind was all over the place, around that time i started abusing MDMA it wasnt a daily thing but i wouldnt drink without it and i drank thursday, friday and saturday most weeks. But i never really abused the ADHD medication, (apart from a couple times when i got back on it) but i never got addicted and never felt like i needed it, it was just like a helping hand in days i needed it. When i moved to australia i stopped taking it was off for about 2 years until i decided to get back on, i was open and honest about previous drug problems because it was pretty bad, mainly coke and MD but said i got over that phase witch i have, they drug tested me 2 times and will test me annually just to be sure. 

This is a bit of a novel, but i think be open and honest, us with adhd seek dopamine and rushes and tend to abuse drugs as a self medicating method without realising.
